provenance: The retained Steam manifest records build 25937608. The preserved shipped-image hash differs from the third-party restored image.
Native records and their resolver/name dependencies were read from the restored image and byte-compared at the same RVAs with a separately reconstructed memory image.

The retained reconstruction receipt binds that memory image to the preserved shipped-image hash. Historical reconstruction used conditional guest fixtures; this task read its saved outputs and did not rerun it.
The original third-party restoration producer remains unknown. Agreement of these selected ranges does not establish provenance, correctness or runnability of the complete restored executable.

method.array_inner_link: Builder decrements the property-pointer cursor before each dispatch. Array dispatch sets one recursive child, so its immediately preceding descriptor is the Inner. Struct construction calls the resolver stored at descriptor+0x50 and installs that UScriptStruct.
method.readable_property_name_binding: Readable fields are joined through the exact canonical idmap owner/member offset and native name length. No hash inversion or plaintext native name recovery is claimed for those fields.

validation.supplemental_map_changes: Exactly these 34 Inner descriptors; original names, schema slots and dimensions retained.
